lines.trans: Arkady, what are we going to do? Samsonov is missing.
She hates me! She doesn't want to talk.
Who? Marina? Our campaign is falling apart!
Give me some useful advice.
Hello! Can you fix my tank?
I can't. Get out of here and close the door!
Why did you chase him away? That is a mistake.
After all, that is her son.
Want a woman to like you? Make friends with her child.
I do not like children. It is boring with them.
But the boy comes with her in the package.
Fine. Later I will send him to study in England.
England is too expensive.
Then he will go study in Bulgaria.
First fix his toy tank.
Good idea! I will try right now.

meanings.en: to fall down, collapse, fall apart
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fall apart, tumble'.

examples.text: Кто? Марина? У нас кампания валится!
examples.trans: Who? Marina? Our campaign is falling apart!

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'door' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'рого'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Французские десерты всегда стоят очень дорого.

meanings.note: a door, a shop, or a legal case

meanings.en: to send (a person, a letter, a message)
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'править'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to send', paired with 'отправлять'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ружиться'). meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'пасть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to disappear, vanish'.

examples.text: Аркадий, что делать будем? Самсонов пропал.

meanings.en: to talk, to speak, to have a conversation
meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'говаривать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to talk, to speak'.
